notes: the marks every manor without a town carries in the MANORS view (owner 2026-09-13): MAN-MADE things only — farmsteads and what the people work, never woods or rocks (owner: the view shows what is made, not what grows). kind hamlet: one farmstead per per_people of the manor's people (the ledger's, so they grow), at most max_count, packed on the manor's SITE (MapObjects.manor_site: by a river or road, back from the coast, down from the heights, or the centre of a plain); kind focus: marks of the chief good worked (focus_code), by per_people too, laid in close rows against the farmsteads on the side away from the water, never over anything and never on a river. aspect is the art's width over its height; height_px in terrain_art.csv units (x map_decor_scale) — a farmstead stays well under a village drawing; flip 1 lets a mark mirror; rotate_deg is unused for rows (a field takes its row's direction); min_scale the zoom the row appears at.
